cohort: All births in Sweden from January 2014 to June 2020 that were included in the Swedish Pregnancy Register (n = 717 336)
finding: This study identified several risk factors for umbilical cord prolapse, including higher parity, non-cephalic presentation, induction of labor, previous cesarean section (with amniotomy), and polyhydramnios (with amniotomy).
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was identified as a risk factor for umbilical cord prolapse in labor when amniotomy is used.
